rot.ideia.ex1.e1: A king never goes next to the other king. So each king is a wall for the other.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: Kings face to face, with one square between them: that is the opposition.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: Whoever has to move gives way. Whoever does not have to move has the opposition.
rot.ideia.ex1.e4: You are White and want to promote the pawn. Put the kings face to face, one square apart.
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: That's right! Kings face to face, one square apart. Black has to move.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The king goes up to e4: face to face with the black king, with e5 between them.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.e3d4.1: That wins too! The king goes up and gains ground in front of the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.e3d4.2: Look also at e4: face to face with the black king, the simplest opposition.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.e3f4.1: That wins too! The king goes up and gains ground in front of the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.e3f4.2: Look also at e4: face to face with the black king, the simplest opposition.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.e3f2.1: The king stays behind and gains no ground.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.e3f2.2: The black king advances and closes the white king's way.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.e3d2.1: The king stays behind and gains no ground.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.e3d2.2: The black king advances and closes the white king's way.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.e3f3.1: The king steps sideways and gains no ground.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.e3f3.2: The black king advances and closes the white king's way.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.e3d3.1: The king steps sideways and gains no ground.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.e3d3.2: The black king advances and closes the white king's way.
rot.ideia.ex1.livre.fala: Play on from here against the machine and see what happens.
rot.ideia.ex1.livre.volta: Let's go back to the position and look for the opposition.
rot.ideia.ex1.fins.capturado: The pawn fell: without the opposition, the black king reached it.
rot.ideia.ex1.fins.afogado: Stalemate: it is a draw. The opposition was missing earlier.
rot.ideia.ex1.fins.repeticao: The position repeated: the black king held the square in front of the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex1.fins.limite: We reached the move limit, and the pawn did not promote.
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: The black king has to move and steps aside.
rot.ideia.ex1.l2: The white king steps ahead and gains ground.
rot.ideia.ex1.l3: Remember: with the opposition, your king clears the way for the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: Now you are Black and want a draw. The white king wants to get past and take the pawn to promotion.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: The opposition also works for defending: whoever has it forces the other king to give way.
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! Now it is the white king who has to give way.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The king goes to e6: face to face with the white king, with e5 between them.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e7f8.1: That move leaves the opposition to the white king.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e7f8.2: The white king advances and clears the way for the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e7e8.1: That move leaves the opposition to the white king.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e7e8.2: The white king advances and clears the way for the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e7d8.1: That move leaves the opposition to the white king.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e7d8.2: The white king advances and clears the way for the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e7f7.1: That move leaves the opposition to the white king.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e7f7.2: The white king advances and clears the way for the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e7d7.1: That move leaves the opposition to the white king.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e7d7.2: The white king advances and clears the way for the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e7f6.1: That move leaves the opposition to the white king.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e7f6.2: The white king advances and clears the way for the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e7d6.1: That move leaves the opposition to the white king.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e7d6.2: The white king advances and clears the way for the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.livre.fala: Play on from here against the machine and see what happens.
rot.ideia.ex2.livre.volta: Let's go back to the position and look for the opposition.
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: The white king cannot go to d5, e5 or f5: they are next to the black king.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: Remember: on either side, whoever has the opposition forces the other to give way.
rot.ideia.ex2.l3: Now I will show the wall between the kings and the opposition all the way to promotion.
rot.demos.parede.e1: Only the two kings. The squares c4, d4 and e4 are forbidden to both.
rot.demos.parede.e2: White has to move. The king cannot go up: the wall is in front.
rot.demos.parede.l2: And the black king gets through and gains ground. The one who had to move gave way.
rot.demos.coroa.e1: The white king is on e6, just in front of the pawn, and has the opposition. Black has to move.
rot.demos.coroa.l2: The white king steps aside and attacks e8, the promotion square.
rot.demos.coroa.l3: The black king tries to come back.
rot.demos.coroa.l6: The pawn reaches e7, protected by the king. Nothing stops promotion.
rot.demos.coroa.l7: The opposition opened the whole way for the pawn.
rot.demos.coroa.l8: Now it's your turn: play against the machine and use the opposition.
rot.pratica.ataque.enunciado: As White: march the king up before the pawn, take the opposition and promote.
rot.pratica.ataque.fim: Well done. With the opposition, the king cleared the way and the pawn promoted.
rot.pratica.defesa.enunciado: As Black: hold the draw. Stay in front of the pawn and take the opposition.
rot.pratica.defesa.fim: Draw secured. The opposition held the white king.
